arguments.title: Clinical Medication Safety and Adherence Platform
arguments.spec:
# Clinical Medication Safety and Adherence Platform — requirements

Decision support for small clinics, home-care nurses, and family caregivers. NOT diagnosis or prescribing.
- Typed domain model (patient, medication-as-concept, schedule, prescriber, pharmacy, caregiver, adherence event) with stable branded ids and an append-only audit history.
- Medication reconciliation comparing imported, patient-reported, and clinician-approved lists; every input keeps source provenance and lands in accepted/rejected/unmatched (totality — nothing vanishes). Unresolvable free text is a first-class BLOCKING unmatched state.
- Concept normalization over an RxNorm-shaped fixture graph (text/brand/NDC -> SCD -> IN); combination products (MIN) decompose to ingredients before any rule runs.
- Rule engine: duplicate active ingredient, therapeutic-class duplication, max daily dose (unit-safe, frequency-folded), allergy with side-chain-graded beta-lactam cross-reactivity, contraindication. Alerts are typed, severity-tiered (interruptive vs passive), evidence-bearing, suppressible within a severity ceiling (contraindicated is never suppressible).
- Suppression memory with provenance (who/when/scope/reason) and expiry on an injected clock.
- Adherence calendar (taken/missed/skipped-by-instruction/held-by-clinician/unknown) and refill-exhaustion forecast, both timezone-deterministic on an injected Clock; clinician holds extend supply.
- Task queue (caregiver follow-up / clinician review / refill request / patient education) where every task traces to facts and rule evidence.
- Plain-language patient summary that never leaks raw scores or clinical directives (denylist-enforced).
- Deterministic seed data: five patients with conflicting histories + the adversarial E4 fixtures. npm test green with zero network.
arguments.plan:
# Implementation plan

Strict dependency order; foundations before workflows, workflows before presentation.
1. Scaffold + core types + injected Clock (s00-s02).
2. Unit-safe dose arithmetic; RxNorm fixture graph; concept resolver with blocking unmatched state; versioned ReferencePack; append-only AuditLog (s03-s08).
3. Shared rule contracts, then the five rules as separate pure modules, then the evaluateRules facade that filters to active items once (s09-s15).
4. Suppression memory: ceiling, audit integration, expiry, fuzz invariant (s16-s19).
5. Reconciliation with totality + property test (s20-s21).
6. Adherence calendar + TZ determinism; refill forecast + held-medication scenario (s22-s25).
7. Task queue + traceability; patient summary + denylist negatives (s26-s29).
8. Seeded patients, adversarial fixtures, flagship integration test (s30-s32).
9. Breadth per the spec recipes: class breadth (s33-s35), audit projections (s36), knowledge-debt ledger (s37), LASA rule (s38), FHIR-shaped import adapter (s39), README (s40).
Every card ships its own tests; npm test is the acceptance command everywhere; no Date.now(), no Math.random(), no network.
arguments.summary: Build the safety spine first — types, clock, dose units, concept resolver, reference pack, audit log — then the five evidence-bearing rules and their facade, then suppression memory, reconciliation, adherence/refill projections, the task queue, and the guarded patient summary, finishing with seeded patients, adversarial fixtures, and a flagship integration test. Breadth cards extend classes, projections, LASA, and a FHIR-shaped import adapter.

tasks.title: Unit-safe dose and quantity arithmetic
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/dose.ts per S03: DoseUnit/FrequencyUnit/WeightUnit, Quantity, Weight, toKg (1 kg = 2.2 lb), frequencyToDailyMultiplier (as-needed -> null), dailyDoseMg folding frequency and weight, and UnitMismatchError. Any unit the function cannot handle must THROW UnitMismatchError, never coerce silently. test/dose.test.ts covers lb->kg, every-6h=4, 500mg qid=2000, 10mg/kg bid at 70kg=1400, missing-weight throw, and as-needed null.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: mg/m2 BSA dosing and renal-interval adjustment are not modeled; a later card must add explicit, pharmacist-reviewed conversion hooks instead of widening this arithmetic.

tasks.title: MedicationConceptResolver with unmatched blocking state
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/medication-concept-resolver.ts per S04: resolve(input) matches exact rxcui, then case-insensitive name, then substring; ambiguity or no match returns { unmatched: { inputText, reason, blocksReconciliation: true } } — never a silent drop. getIngredients decomposes MIN/SCD/SBD to IN-level rxcuis. Tests cover Tylenol -> SBD, case-insensitive SCD lookup, 'a water pill' -> unmatched, and MIN decomposition to both INs.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Real NDC mapping has obsolete/repackager ambiguity the fixture graph cannot express; the unmatched/ambiguous path is the extension point and its limits are recorded debt.
acceptanceChecks: 'a water pill' resolves to unmatched with blocksReconciliation true
the Acetaminophen/Hydrocodone MIN decomposes to both ingredient INs
nonGoals: No live RxNorm/NDC directory calls; the fixture graph is the only source

tasks.title: Append-only AuditLog
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/audit-log.ts per S06: AuditEventType union, AuditEvent, and class AuditLog with append (deterministic counter ids), getAll, getByPatient — returned arrays are copies so callers cannot mutate history. Tests assert sequential ids '1'/'2', insertion order, patient filtering, and immutability of the returned array.

tasks.title: Max-daily-dose rule with frequency folding
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/max-dose.ts: checkMaxDailyDose(facts, regimen, pack) computes each ACTIVE item's daily mg via dailyDoseMg (folding frequency, using facts.weightKg for weight-based units) and fires a serious 'max-dose' alert when a pack doseCeiling for a resolved ingredient is exceeded. UnitMismatchError must propagate, never be swallowed. Test: APAP 1500mg qid (6000/day) fires against the 4000 ceiling; 500mg bid does not; as-needed items are skipped.

tasks.title: evaluateRules facade over the five rules
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rule-engine.ts: evaluateRules(facts, regimen, pack) filters the regimen to status 'active' ONCE, then concatenates dup-ingredient, dup-class, max-dose, allergy, and contraindication results (pure function, no I/O). Held/stopped items must never reach any rule. test/rule-engine.test.ts re-runs the S07 acceptance table: SSRI duplication, APAP 6000 over-ceiling, amoxicillin exact allergy, cephalexin moderate cross-reactivity, aztreonam informational, contraindicated pair unsuppressible, held item silent, and evidence.length >= 1 on every alert.
acceptanceChecks: held medications produce zero alerts across all five rules

tasks.title: Reconciliation workflow with source provenance
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/reconciliation.ts per S09: MedicationSource, ReconciliationItem (conceptId nullable, inputText, source, provenance), Discrepancy, and pure reconcile(items, resolver, clinicianApprovedIds, clock) -> { accepted, rejected, unmatched, discrepancies }. TOTALITY is the law: every input lands in exactly one of accepted/rejected/unmatched with provenance preserved — resolver-unmatched items go to unmatched (blocking), never dropped. Classify conservative 'unintentional' when in doubt; clinician-approved items absent from imports classify 'intentional-documented'.

tasks.title: Adherence calendar summary
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/adherence-calendar.ts per S10: AdherenceEvent and summarizeAdherence(events, patientId, conceptId, periodStart, periodEnd) counting taken/missed/skippedByInstruction/heldByClinician/unknown over [periodStart, periodEnd) — pure counts, no percentages, no Date.now(). Tests: a 10-event set counts exactly, out-of-period events are excluded, and two identical calls are deeply equal.

tasks.title: Refill-exhaustion forecast on the injected clock
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/refill-forecast.ts per S11: forecastRefill(conceptId, lastFillDate, remainingQuantityMg, dose, frequency, knownHoldDays, clock, weightKg?) -> RefillForecast. Hold days extend supply (adjustedRemaining = remaining + holdDays*dailyDose); projectedExhaustionDate anchors to lastFillDate; daysUntilExhaustion floors against clock.now(); isAtRisk <= 7 days; as-needed yields nulls and isAtRisk false. Tests: 100mg at 10mg/day clock at +5d => ~5 days left; +7 hold days shifts the date 7 days; as-needed returns nulls.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Renal/hepatic dose adjustment and partial fills are not modeled; the forecast assumes constant consumption between fills. Flagged for pharmacist review before production use.

tasks.title: Plain-language patient summary with denylist
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/patient-summary.ts per S13: SUMMARY_DENYLIST (raw mg/score numerics; diagnose/treat/prescribe directive verbs) and generatePatientSummary(patientId, regimen, adherenceSummary, forecasts, openTasks, clock). Adherence note in plain dose-count English; refill reminders in DAYS only (never mg); only caregiver-follow-up and patient-education tasks surface to patients; every emitted string is checked against the denylist and a violation THROWS. Tests: adherence sentence present, at-risk reminder present, clinician-review tasks hidden, injected raw score throws.

tasks.title: Flagship integration test over seeded patients
tasks.prompt: Create test/integration.test.ts wiring S01-S31 together over PATIENT_FIXTURES: patient a fires dup-ingredient (MIN decomposition proof); b gets moderate for cephalexin and informational for aztreonam; c fires max-dose; d evaluates without UnitMismatchError; e's moderate DDI records an always-for-pair suppression and isSuppressed flips true while a contraindicated suppression attempt throws; every alert has evidence.length >= 1; reconciliation of 'a water pill' lands unmatched; the whole suite is identical across two consecutive runs with the same FixedClock.
preconditions: all rule cards, suppression, reconciliation, and fixtures merged (s15/s16/s20/s31)
acceptanceChecks: all five patients produce their expected alert profile
suppression replay demotes the moderate DDI and refuses the contraindicated one
npm test green with zero network calls
